title: A town from OpenStreetMap
description: One line of localities/localities.ndjson, written by pipeline.extract --localities at each sync: an OSM node tagged place=city, town or village, with its name, and the local government area (boundary=administrative, admin_level=6) it lies in. pipeline.database turns the file into the localities table.

population.description: The node's population tag, when it is a whole number.
